name: FPDS — FleetPanda Design System
gapMessage: This unit needs a tweak in design/new design. Please contact the owner to get a design for this gap, pavanshetty@fleetpanda.com.

entries.title: Button
entries.purpose: The one pressable action. Says what happens next.
useWhen: Use when a press does something: commit, open, add, export.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a two-state choice (→ `atom.toggle` / `atom.toggle-group`), a chip (→ `atom.pill`), or an add on a table (→ `molecule.hanging-add`).

entries.title: Toggle
entries.purpose: A single on/off pressable — a button that stays pressed.
useWhen: Use for a single view option that is on or off.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a setting in a form (→ `atom.switch` in a menu, `atom.checkbox` in a table/form); for one of several (→ `atom.toggle-group`).

entries.title: Toggle group
entries.purpose: A segment control: pick one (or several) of a few short options that change a view.
useWhen: Use for 2–5 short scopes on a dashboard or list (line of service, version).
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a form field with many options (→ `atom.select` / `molecule.combobox`), or for switching between views of one record (→ `atom.tabs`). Not for line-of-service on lists — that is a filter.

entries.title: Input
entries.purpose: A one-line text or number field.
useWhen: Use for free text, a number, an email, a phone.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for prose (→ `atom.textarea`), a fixed list (→ `atom.select` / `molecule.combobox`), a date (→ `molecule.date-field`), or a read-only value (→ `molecule.copy-value`). Inside an editable table use the `TableCell*` cells, never a bare Input.

entries.title: Textarea
entries.purpose: Multi-line prose — notes, instructions, reasons.
useWhen: Use for notes and free-form text longer than a line.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a single value (→ `atom.input`).

entries.title: Select
entries.purpose: Pick one value from a short fixed list.
useWhen: Use for a short, closed list where search adds nothing.
dontUseWhen: Don't use when the list can grow, needs search, a second line per option, an empty choice or create (→ `molecule.combobox` — every list searches by default). In a table cell use `TableCellSelect`.

entries.title: Checkbox
entries.purpose: A boolean, or one pick in a multi-pick list.
useWhen: Use for every boolean in a table or form (Top off, row select, facet options, multi-pick rows).
dontUseWhen: Don't use a switch or toggle for a table boolean.

entries.title: Radio group
entries.purpose: Pick one of 2–4 options that each need their words visible.
useWhen: Use when every option should be read before choosing (fill type, scope of an edit).
dontUseWhen: Don't use for long lists (→ `atom.select` / `molecule.combobox`) or view scopes (→ `atom.toggle-group`).

entries.title: Switch
entries.purpose: Turn a setting on or off immediately, outside a table.
useWhen: Use in a menu of settings (card fields) or a settings row that applies at once.
dontUseWhen: Don't use in a table cell or for a form boolean that a list compares (→ `atom.checkbox`).

entries.title: Slider
entries.purpose: Choose a value or range on a continuous scale.
useWhen: Use for a level that is felt rather than typed (Accessibility sliders) or as the track inside a window control.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a delivery window in a form (→ `DeliveryWindowTimeline` unit), or an exact number (→ `atom.input`).

entries.title: Label
entries.purpose: Names a field.
useWhen: Use above (or beside) every field and for a checkbox / radio's words.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for section headings or helper text.

entries.title: Calendar
entries.purpose: The month grid inside the date picker.
useWhen: Use only inside `DatePickerPanel` (via `molecule.date-field`, `DateRangePopover`, `DatePanel`).
dontUseWhen: Don't use a bare Popover + Calendar on a screen (→ `molecule.date-field`). Exception: the technician phone app's full-width calendar.

entries.title: Badge
entries.purpose: The DS's low-level chip geometry and the round counter (`BadgeNumber`).
useWhen: Use `BadgeNumber` for a counter inside a button or nav item; `shape="disc"` only through `atom.code-disc`; `verified` for the verified mark.
dontUseWhen: Don't use Badge for a status, tag, flag or "+N" (→ `atom.pill` / `atom.status-chip`).

entries.title: Pill
entries.purpose: The chip and badge of the system — a status, tag, flag, type or "+N".
useWhen: Use for every chip/badge: status (via `atom.status-chip`), a table's Type column (full word), flags (Urgent, Over SLA), "+N".
dontUseWhen: Don't use for plain text values (products, driver names), counters in buttons (→ `BadgeNumber`), board-card type initials (→ `atom.code-disc`).

entries.title: Status chip
entries.purpose: A status word, drawn as a pill in its kind's color.
useWhen: Use in every status column, sheet header and board card.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for tags / types (→ `atom.pill`). `variant="dot"` only for a dense grid where coloured words would shout.

entries.title: Avatar
entries.purpose: A person's picture or initials.
useWhen: Use for a person: profile, assignee stacks.
dontUseWhen: Don't use as a type marker (→ `atom.code-disc`).

entries.title: Kbd
entries.purpose: Shows a keyboard key or shortcut.
useWhen: Use beside a command that has a shortcut (global search).
dontUseWhen: Don't use as a chip or tag.

entries.title: Code disc
entries.purpose: A type's initial in a 22px pastel circle, where only a letter fits.
useWhen: Use **only on board cards**.
dontUseWhen: Don't use in a table (→ `atom.pill` with the full word and `discTonePill(tone)`).

entries.title: File type icon
entries.purpose: Shows a file's format beside its name.
useWhen: Use left of every uploaded file's name.
dontUseWhen: Don't use as a generic document icon in menus.

entries.title: Metric icon (term icons)
entries.purpose: The tile a figure card wears, and the one icon per term.
useWhen: Use `MetricIcon` on metric / figure cards and dashboard units; use `TERM_ICONS` wherever deliveries, products, gallons or ship-tos are named.
dontUseWhen: Don't use trend lines on figure cards; don't draw a different icon for a term.

entries.title: Quiet pattern
entries.purpose: The one decorative fill for an empty stretch of a card.
useWhen: Use as the last child of a card's flex column with leftover space.
dontUseWhen: Don't place it in sheets by hand (`RecordSheet` does it when content ≤ 50% of the body); never behind text.

entries.title: Tooltip
entries.purpose: Names an icon-only control, or why something is disabled.
useWhen: Use on every icon-only button and on a disabled control with a reason.
dontUseWhen: Don't use to repeat visible text, or over a value someone may copy (`molecule.copy-value` has none).

entries.title: Popover
entries.purpose: A floating panel anchored to a control.
useWhen: Use for pickers (combobox, date), breakdowns, filter panels.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a task that needs focus held (→ `atom.dialog`) or a record (→ `atom.sheet`). Not for the Accessibility panel (fixed, because zoom misplaces popovers).

entries.title: Dropdown menu
entries.purpose: A list of actions (or checkable options) from one trigger.
useWhen: Use for a row's ⋯ actions, Group By, Show / hide columns, a hanging add with a choice of row.
dontUseWhen: Don't use to pick a field's value (→ `atom.select` / `molecule.combobox`).

entries.title: Dialog
entries.purpose: A focused task over the page that must be finished or dismissed.
useWhen: Use for a short decision with inputs (bulk edit, award a quote).
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a record (→ `atom.sheet`) or a yes/no (→ `atom.alert-dialog`).

entries.title: Alert dialog
entries.purpose: A yes/no that guards an irreversible or lossy act.
useWhen: Use for "Discard this order?" on closing an unsaved create, cancelling an order, deleting a record.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for row deletes in editable tables (→ inline ✕/✓ `TableRowRemove`).

entries.title: Sheet
entries.purpose: The side panel primitive under every record sheet.
useWhen: Use through `RecordSheet` (the unit), which sets width, depth, steps, footer and autosave.
dontUseWhen: Don't build a record screen on a bare `SheetContent`.

entries.title: Skeleton
entries.purpose: Holds a part's place while it loads.
useWhen: Use for each part of a loading page in its own place (title, tabs, toolbar, header, rows).
dontUseWhen: Don't use a spinner for a page.

entries.title: Spinner
entries.purpose: A small in-place "working" mark.
useWhen: Use inside a button or a toast while one act runs.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for loading a page or list (→ `atom.skeleton`).

entries.title: Progress
entries.purpose: How far a known amount has got.
useWhen: Use for a share of a whole with a known end.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a tank level (→ `molecule.level-gauge`) or a lifecycle (→ `molecule.stage-track`).

entries.title: Outline shine
entries.purpose: A soft band sweeping across an element's outline (or face) to draw the eye without changing it.
useWhen: Use on AlertBanner CTAs (white) and pills (sweep, `fill`) — added by the banner; on the dashboard "Attention required" tile (red); a nudge on a single button.
dontUseWhen: Don't add it from a screen to an AlertBanner (the banner does it); don't use on a ghost button with no outline.

entries.title: Separator
entries.purpose: A structural divider.
useWhen: Use between toolbar clusters and between menu groups.
dontUseWhen: Don't use to separate stepped-form groups (the 40px gap does it) or as a card edge.

entries.title: Scroll area
entries.purpose: A scrolling region with a slim custom thumb.
useWhen: Use rarely — the app hides scrollbars by default.
dontUseWhen: Don't use to bring back visible scrollbars on lanes or lists.

entries.title: Tabs
entries.purpose: Switch between views of one thing.
useWhen: Use for views of one record or settings page; `line` variant for page-level tabs.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for ordered steps (→ `molecule.stage-track` / Steps) or list views (the view row: All + saved views).

entries.title: Search field
entries.purpose: Search every column of a list from the toolbar.
useWhen: Use as the list toolbar's search — one per list, every list.
dontUseWhen: Don't use to search one column (→ Search by column, the filter row under the header) or inside a picker (the Command input does that).

entries.title: Filter chip
entries.purpose: Show which filters are on, one removable pill per facet, under the toolbar.
useWhen: Use whenever a list has applied filters or an active column search.
dontUseWhen: Don't use a count badge on the Filters button instead ("Filters 7" is not an answer).

entries.title: Icon tool
entries.purpose: An icon-only toolbar control named by a tooltip — view switch and view tools.
useWhen: Use for the display icons (Table · Board · Map) and the view's tools (Search by column, Show/hide columns, Card configuration).
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a labeled action (→ `atom.button` with text).

entries.title: Status pill
entries.purpose: A record's status in a cell, header or card — the status word in its kind's color.
useWhen: Use in every status column, every sheet header status, every board card.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a type or tag (→ `atom.pill` with `color`), or where every row has the same value (render nothing).

entries.title: Two-line cell
entries.purpose: A record's name with the one fact that tells it apart, in one cell.
useWhen: Use for a customer + location, an order + product, a rule + schedule summary.
dontUseWhen: Don't use to stack two unrelated values (give each its column).

entries.title: Overflow chip
entries.purpose: Shows the first value and a "+N" pill that opens the rest.
useWhen: Use when a cell holds a list (products, ship-tos, assets).
dontUseWhen: Don't use a hover list or a tooltip for the rest.

entries.title: Breakdown popover
entries.purpose: What a "+N" chip or a total is made of.
useWhen: Use behind any "+N" or figure that sums things (quantity, amount, level on fulfillment).
dontUseWhen: Don't use as a general popover form.

entries.title: Trend chip
entries.purpose: The one up / down marker for a change against a period.
useWhen: Use after the figure on every figure card, with "vs N the previous …" under it.
dontUseWhen: Don't use arrows in circles, orange, `destructive` red or trend lines on figure cards.

entries.title: Copy value
entries.purpose: A read-only value with its own copy button.
useWhen: Use for contact facts someone pastes elsewhere: phone, email, IDs.
dontUseWhen: Don't use a disabled input for read-only values; don't put one copy button over two values.

entries.title: Combobox
entries.purpose: A select you can type into — the default picker for any list of records.
useWhen: Use for customers, ship-tos, products, vendors, technicians — any list that can grow; with `allowCreate` for open sets (roles, tags).
dontUseWhen: Don't use for several values in one field (→ `molecule.token-multi-select`) or inside an editable table (→ `TableCellCombobox`, with `multiple` when it adds rows).

entries.title: Token multi-select
entries.purpose: Several values for one field, shown as chips, added from a searchable list.
useWhen: Use for tags, products on a bulk edit, products on a recurring program — values that live in ONE field.
dontUseWhen: Don't use when each pick should become its own table row (→ `TableCellSelect multiple`, see "Picking several makes rows").

entries.title: Date field
entries.purpose: A form field that holds one date, opening the shared picker.
useWhen: Use for every single date in a form (planned date, end date). `DateKeyField` when the value is stored as `YYYY-MM-DD` with an optional `min`.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a list's date range (→ `DateRangeFilter` / `DateRangePopover`) or a hand-built Popover + Calendar.

entries.title: Time-window slider
entries.purpose: A time range on a drawn day, in 30-minute steps.
useWhen: Use only where it stands today: the technician phone app (Service › TechnicianHome). Its formatters (`formatMinutes`, `formatWindow`, `formatSpan`) are shared.
**Don't use for a new delivery or scheduling window** — every window in every module is `DeliveryWindowTimeline` (preferred-time bars, hanging +). `(DS ui §10m, 2026-10-20)`
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a new delivery or scheduling window** — every window in every module is `DeliveryWindowTimeline` (preferred-time bars, hanging +). `(DS ui §10m, 2026-10-20)`

entries.title: Hanging add
entries.purpose: The add for a table that can grow — a tab off the card's bottom-left corner.
useWhen: Use under every boxed table that adds rows (products, vendors, fees, preferred times).
dontUseWhen: Don't use a full-width "add row" band inside the card; don't render it on a fixed table.

entries.title: Stage track
entries.purpose: Where a record is in its lifecycle, or which step of a form you are on — one look for both.
useWhen: Use `StageTrack` for a record's stages on its detail; `Steps` / `SheetSteps` for a stepped create form (passes `onStageClick`).
dontUseWhen: Don't use tabs for steps; don't show off-line states (Canceled, Blocked) as a position — nothing is current then.

entries.title: Level gauge
entries.purpose: A tank's level, its monitor's battery and its days to empty — each in its own cell.
useWhen: Use in asset / tank columns where a monitor reports levels.
dontUseWhen: Don't add band words ("Low"); don't propose level-triggered rules (Pavan raises those).

entries.title: Stat tile
entries.purpose: A headline number on a module dashboard that opens the rows it counts.
useWhen: Use for headline counts on the 3PL and Sales dashboards.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a figure with a period change and term icon (→ figure card with `atom.metric-icon` + `molecule.trend-chip`).

entries.title: Toast
entries.purpose: Confirms an act that leaves the screen, in one line.
useWhen: Use after create, export, status change, cancel.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for an in-place copy (`molecule.copy-value` ticks), autosave, or a validation error (pending bar).

entries.title: Empty state
entries.purpose: Tells the reader why a whole region has nothing in it (variant E3).
useWhen: Use when a whole list / region is empty and needs a reason (no results for the filters, nothing yet).
dontUseWhen: Don't use for an empty table inside a form (→ one blank row, or padded text E1); never a dashed box round an empty table (E2 is only an optional section that is off).

entries.title: List page
entries.purpose: Show many records of one kind, let the reader narrow, sort, group, save the narrowing as a view, switch between table, board and map, open a record and act on many at once.
useWhen: Use when the job is "find / scan / work through records of one kind" — orders, quotes,
customers, vendors, parts, invoices, agreements, technicians…
Use the **table-only** variant (`StandardList`) when the records have no lifecycle
lanes or places (reference lists: Price Book, Parts, Invoices, Team & Access).
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a single record (→ Record sheet) or for figures over time (→ Dashboard).

entries.title: Record sheet
entries.purpose: Create, edit or read ONE record in a side sheet over its list, without leaving the list.
useWhen: Use for every create and every edit — orders, quotes, customers, assets, service
orders, rules, users — even for a record the product has never had before.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a dashboard drill (→ List page narrowed) or a bulk change (→ Bulk edit).

entries.title: Directory record
entries.purpose: Read and keep one master-data record — a customer, vendor, product or rental asset — with its properties, related records and activity.
useWhen: Use for master data (customers, vendors, products, assets, ship-tos).
dontUseWhen: Don't use for transactional records like orders (→ Record sheet).

entries.title: Dashboard
entries.purpose: Answer "how are we doing today, and what needs me" for one module, and send the reader to the records behind every number.
useWhen: Use for a module's landing figures.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for one record's figures (→ Directory record) or for analytics (later phase).

entries.title: Settings page
entries.purpose: Set how a module behaves for the whole tenant.
useWhen: Use for module-wide configuration.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for personal preferences (→ Accessibility panel) or one record (→ Record sheet).

entries.title: App frame
entries.purpose: The frame every page sits in: top bar, navigation, content layer.
useWhen: Use for every page.
dontUseWhen: Don't build a page without it.

entries.title: Alert banner
entries.purpose: Tells the reader what on this list needs attention now, and lets them act on it in place: narrow the list to it, step through several kinds, act on an item, snooze or dismiss. Answers "what needs me on this page, and where is it?"
useWhen: Use when a banner ACTS on the page: it applies a filter, holds several kinds of alert, or lists items each with its own action. That is the B2 banner, `AlertBanner`, and it carries the whole anatomy.
Use on a list page for standing conditions (overdue, needs action, at risk, past due).
dontUseWhen: Don't use when the banner only says one thing with at most one action or a ✕ — use the B1 banner without interaction, `BannerCallout` (solid · soft) or `BannerInline` (same files, `banner.tsx`).
Don't dress a one-line message in B2 parts: no filter, no items and no stepping = B1.
Don't use for the dashboard's **Attention required** tiles — a different pattern by design (red outline shine on the banner), not an `AlertBanner`.
Don't use to explain why a control is disabled — that is a tooltip on the press (interactions §7b).

entries.title: App shell
entries.purpose: The frame every page sits in: the top bar (brand, global search, notifications, account), the one-panel navigation (modules and their pages, Accessibility at its foot) and the content layer. It answers "where am I, where can I go, and how do I find anything".
useWhen: Use when building any page of the Unified View (3PL, Sales, Service Work, Pricing, Lease) or the Customer Portal — the portal reuses `AppShell`, `TopBar` and `ModuleSidebar` with one module.
Use `ModuleSkeleton` for a module's page while its data loads after a module switch.
dontUseWhen: Don't use the two-layer rail + drawer (`NavRail` + `NavigationDrawer`) — it is kept behind `NAV_STYLE = "two-layer"` and comes back only when Pavan says "Bring in the two-layer navigation drawers".
Don't put a theme toggle in the top bar — Light/Dark lives only in the Accessibility panel.
Don't put Profile or Settings in the navigation — they are in the account menu.

entries.title: Board
entries.purpose: Shows a list's records as cards in lanes, one lane per stage of the record's lifecycle, read left to right. Answers "where is every order in the work, and which ones need me?"
useWhen: Use when the records move through a status workflow (orders, service work) and the list offers a board view (`ListToolbar boardView`).
Use when a stage's cards need to say different things per stage (card fields are per lane).
dontUseWhen: Don't use when the list has no workflow — Customers, Assets, Directory lists, standing arrangements (no lanes to put them in) → use the list table.
Don't use when the question is geographic ("what else goes out near this one") → use `unit.map`.
Don't use for a one-view list: no view switch, no board icon (ui §10h).

entries.title: Bulk bar & bulk edit
entries.purpose: Acts on several ticked rows at once: change one field across them, or apply an action (archive, delete, export). Answers "do this to all of these — and show me what will change before it does."
useWhen: Use when a list table has row checkboxes and rows are ticked.
Use the field actions + `BulkEditDialog` when the edit changes a value per row (date, time, driver, products, tags).
Use `BulkActionBar` with its own `actions` for a list whose verbs are its own (3PL Directory).
dontUseWhen: Don't use on a board — row ticks live in the table (Sales › Orders shows the bar in the table view only).
Don't use for a property of the whole round (e.g. "ask these for a price") — that is a switch over the round, not a selection.
Don't build a second bar in place — pass `actions` to the one bar.

entries.title: Chip shelf
entries.purpose: The one-line strip under the toolbar that says out loud which filters are on, and takes them off. It answers "why is this list shorter than I expect, and how do I undo it?"
useWhen: Use on every list that has a Filters panel — directly after `unit.toolbar`, inside the same `mt-4` shelf.
Use `ColumnSearchChip` as a child when the list still has the one-column search (popover form) — it joins the same shelf.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for the column search row's boxes — those are visible in the table itself (`unit.data-table`).
Don't use in the Export sheet — that sheet lists narrowings as rows of chips per category (`unit.export-sheet`).
Don't use for form token chips — same pill recipe, different unit.

entries.title: Dashboard tiles & cards
entries.purpose: A module's overview: a few figures, charts and short tables that say how much work there is, where it sits and what needs somebody now. In the Unified View every figure is a way into the list it counts; in the Customer Portal it is a few things for the customer to glance at, with "Attention required" first.
useWhen: Use when a module needs an overview page — 3PL and Sales (Unified View, built from `DashboardParts`) or the Customer Portal landing page.
Use the figure-card style (figure · `TrendChip` · "vs …" line · `MetricIcon`) for any metric card that leads with a number, in any module.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a list's own filtering cards above a table — those are list overview cards, not a dashboard.
Don't use for a banner that acts on a list — use `unit.alert-banner`. The dashboard's "Attention required" is a different pattern by design.
Don't use for a report to generate and take away — Customer Portal "Delivery performance" is a report on the Reports page, not a dashboard card.
Don't build a cross-module dashboard; Lease and Pricing have none.

entries.title: Data table
entries.purpose: The list's table: every record a row, every column sortable, movable and resizable, the whole row opening the record. It answers "which records match, in what order — and let me open one."
useWhen: Use for the table display of any list page (with `unit.view-bar` as its `topBar`).
Use `alignTop` when rows grow tall with stacked child lines (Customer Portal › Orders: one line per tank).
Use grouped rows (`nodes`) when the toolbar's Group by is on.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for an editable table inside a sheet or form — that is the boxed table unit (ui §10f, `TableCell*`).
Don't use for a list with no list chrome — a table page always comes with the whole unit (ui §10c); prefer `unit.standard-list`.

entries.title: Date picker
entries.purpose: The one date picker for every screen that picks a date — a list's date filter and a form's date field alike: named presets, a calendar, typed dates, a live count, and nothing changes until Apply. It answers "which day or window do I mean, and how many records fall in it?"
useWhen: Use the **range** form (default) for a list's date window: toolbar stepper `DateRangeFilter` (3PL › Delivery Orders, Sales › Orders, Service Work › Service Orders, Customer Portal › Orders) or `DateRangePopover` behind your own trigger.

Use the **single** form (`select="single"`) for a field that holds one date: `DateField` (a `Date`), `DateKeyField` (a `YYYY-MM-DD` key, optional `min`), or `DatePopover` + `DatePanel` as a drop-in for a Popover + single Calendar in an existing form.
Use `DateFilter` (‹ one day ›) for a list scoped to one day (the toolbar's `dateScope`).
dontUseWhen: Don't use a bare `Calendar` in a popover, or any other picker.
Don't use in the technician phone app — it keeps its full-width calendar (no room for a rail).

entries.title: Delivery window & preferred time
entries.purpose: One day drawn once, full width: the delivery window as a range on a 24-hour track, and the customer's preferred times as bars on the same scale beneath it. It answers "between when can we deliver, and when would they rather we came".
useWhen: Use for every delivery or scheduling window in every module — order sheets, recurring rules, a ship-to's default hours, a service order's scheduling window.
dontUseWhen: Don't use `TimeWindowSlider` for a new window — it remains only in the technician mobile app (`TechnicianHome`); its formatters are still shared.
Don't use a dropdown of fixed windows — a window is two times, not a category.
Don't use where a module has no window (Sales orders).
Don't use for a single moment (a date) — use the DS date field in the record sheet's field row.

entries.title: Documents table
entries.purpose: The one table for files kept on a record — BOLs, tickets, invoices, dispute evidence. It answers "what files does this record have, when did they arrive, who added them?" and, where allowed, lets the reader add one.
useWhen: Use when any record keeps files (order, invoice dispute, order request).
dontUseWhen: Don't use a gallery, a card grid or an empty-state panel for documents.
Don't use it for lines or other editable rows — use `unit.lines-table` / the boxed table.

entries.title: Export sheet
entries.purpose: The side sheet that opens from a list's Export button and shows exactly what is about to leave — the same rows you are looking at, the narrowings that made them, how many — before you pick a format and export. It answers "what am I exporting, and is that what I mean?"
useWhen: Use for every list's Export (the `Upload` icon at the right end of `unit.view-row`).
dontUseWhen: Don't export silently from the toolbar — the sheet is the only path.
Don't use for importing, for printing a single record, or for downloading a document from a row (Customer Portal › Invoices' Download column is its own cell).
Don't use as a place to build a different filter — it edits the list's own state.

entries.title: Filter panel
entries.purpose: The faceted filter behind the toolbar's **Filters** button: pick values in one or more categories, see how many rows they leave, then apply. It answers "show me only the rows with these values — and how many is that before I commit?"
useWhen: Use when a list has category columns worth narrowing by (status, type, customer, line of service, business…). Every list's Filters button opens this panel.

Use the same control with a full-width trigger (`fullWidth`) inside `unit.export-sheet` — it stages until Apply exactly as on the toolbar, and keeps no Recent history. (`ListFilterPanel`, the body alone, exists for a flat layout; no screen uses it today.)
dontUseWhen: Don't use for free text (that is the toolbar search or the column search row in `unit.data-table`), for numbers, amounts or dates (date → `unit.date-picker`).
Don't use for a split flipped many times a session that is exhaustive and short — that is a quick filter in `unit.toolbar` (ui §10c).

entries.title: Lines table
entries.purpose: The order's lines as an editable table: which tank or asset gets which product, and how much. It answers "what is going onto this truck, into which tank" — one row per asset, every cell typed into in place.
useWhen: Use when a record holds a repeated line of asset · product · quantity — a fuel order, a recurring rule's ship-to, a portal order. Repeated inputs are a table by default; never a stack of fields.
Use the Sales variant (`ProductTable`: Product · Quantity, plus priced columns for a quote) where the line has no asset.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for documents — use `unit.documents-table`.
Don't use for a one-off value (one product, one quantity) — that is a field row in the record sheet (`unit.record-sheet`).
Don't use for several values that belong in ONE cell (work types, categories) — that is `TableCellMultiSelect` inside a row, not rows.

entries.title: List view
entries.purpose: Shows a board's records as a slim list on the left and the picked record's own sheet docked on the right, so a reader can read the same section across many records without opening and closing each one. After Dynamics 365's List view.
useWhen: Use when the list has a board (`boardView`) and its records open a `RecordSheet` — 3PL Delivery Orders (V3), Sales Orders, Service Work.
dontUseWhen: Don't use in the Customer Portal — customer-facing; CP features do not auto-spread.
Don't use for lists without a sheet to dock, or without status steps → the table.

entries.title: Map
entries.purpose: Shows the list's orders as a list on the left and pins at their ship-to sites on the right, one selection across both. Answers "what else is going out near this one?" — a question no column can sort.
useWhen: Use when the list's records are geographic (orders with a ship-to) and the toolbar offers `mapView`.
Use in the Customer Portal with live trucks for orders out for delivery.
dontUseWhen: Don't use when records have no place (Customers, Directory lists) — `mapView` stays off; no dead icon.
Don't use for picking or placing one location on a record (ship-to / asset address) — that is the record sheet's own Leaflet map, not this unit.
Don't use for workflow stage → `unit.board`; for columns → the list table.

entries.title: Pagination
entries.purpose: The footer under a list's table: where you are in the list, a way to the other pages, and how many rows a page holds. While the table is grouped, the grouped footer stands in and reports the list's shape instead. It answers "which slice am I seeing, and how do I see the rest?"
useWhen: Use `TablePagination` under every paged list table, in its own `mt-4 shrink-0` block.
Use `GroupedListFooter` instead while Group by is on (the list scrolls whole).
dontUseWhen: Don't use under a board or map display.
Don't use for an editable table inside a sheet (those show all rows).
Don't replace it with a count ("24 rules") — a count is not a page position.

entries.title: Record sheet
entries.purpose: The right-hand side sheet that creates or edits ONE record — an order, a quote, a customer, an asset, a rule. It answers "what is this record, what does it still need, and what is the next thing to do with it?" Create and edit are the same sheet.
useWhen: Use when a single record is created, read or edited from a list, board, map or dashboard tile.
Use `level={2}` when the sheet opens over another sheet (invite partner over an order, a vendor quote, a dispute over an invoice).
dontUseWhen: Don't use for a bulk change across many records — use `unit.bulk-bar` (Bulk edit).
Don't use for a list's filters/export controls as a form — those are a `compact` sheet of controls, not a record.
Don't build a page or modal for a record's create form — a separate create screen is how two descriptions of one record come to exist.

entries.title: Recurring section
entries.purpose: An optional section on any order that can repeat: a dashed "Add Recurring Order" row until it is asked for, then the recurring rule's own frequency unit in a box. It answers "does this order repeat, on which days or dates, how often, until when" — set the same way wherever a repeat is set.
useWhen: Use on every order sheet whose order can repeat (3PL Delivery Order, Customer Portal order).
Use the frequency unit alone (`RuleFrequencyPicker`, in a "Frequency" section) inside a recurring RULE form, where repeating is the whole point.
dontUseWhen: Don't use on Service Work service orders (they don't repeat — Agreements/Maintenance do) or Sales orders.
Don't use on 3PL movement (asset) orders, or on a portal order made by a rule (the rule owns the repeating).
Don't use a checkbox + frequency dropdown or a list of cadences.

entries.title: Standard list
entries.purpose: A template-level composition written as a unit card — the whole list page in one piece, built from `unit.view-row`, `unit.toolbar`, `unit.filter-panel`, `unit.chip-shelf`, `unit.view-bar`, `unit.data-table`, `unit.export-sheet` and `unit.pagination`. Every table page, assembled the same way: the view row, the toolbar, the chip shelf, the view bar on the table, pagination, and an export that asks first. A screen hands it rows, columns, what each column prints, its facets and what Create and opening a row do. It answers "show me this kind of record as a list I can search, filter, sort, save and export" — identically on every page.
useWhen: Use for any page whose content is one table of one kind of record with no board or map: Customer Portal lists, Service Work reference pages.
Use `ServiceListScreen` (a thin wrapper) for a reference page whose filters should come from its own columns automatically.
dontUseWhen: Don't use when the list needs a board, a map, a date window, Group by or bulk selection — those lists compose the units directly (3PL › Delivery Orders, Sales › Orders, Service Work › Service Orders, Customer Portal › Orders).
Don't use inside a side sheet or for an editable table (boxed table unit, ui §10f).

entries.title: Status & awaiting pills
entries.purpose: Says what state a record is in, as its word in a pill coloured by what the reader should do about it. The Awaiting pill says a customer's ask (change or cancellation) is waiting on the tenant, without inventing a status. Flags say what is wrong or about to be.
useWhen: Use the **status pill** (`StatusChip`, default variant) in every status column, sheet header, board card badge and map list row.
Use a **badge pill** (`Pill kind=…`) for flags and tags on a card: Urgent, Over SLA, Needs approval, Recurring, "Best price", "+N".
Use the **Awaiting pill** beside the status when a Customer Portal order carries a `changeRequest`.
Use **Flags as plain coloured text** in the Customer Portal Orders Flags column.
dontUseWhen: Don't use `variant="dot"` unless a dense grid is asked for it by name.
Don't use a pill for button / nav counters (`BadgeNumber`), the board lane count, or type initials (`CodeDisc`).
Don't make "Change requested" / "Cancellation requested" a status or a lane — use the Awaiting pill.

entries.title: Summary rail & activity
entries.purpose: The read-only right column of a record sheet: the **Summary card** shows what the form computes (totals, counts, the headline figure), the **Activity card** shows the record's history. It answers "what has this record become?" and "what happened to it, when, by whom?".
useWhen: Use when a record sheet has a derived side — figures computed from what is typed, or a history.
Use `RailCard` + `RailRow` for other read-only facts in the rail (e.g. Service Work "Record", "Payment", "Visits").
dontUseWhen: Don't use while CREATING a record — create sheets have no rail (exception: the Customer Portal order sheet keeps its summary on the right while creating).
Don't put editable values in the rail — they belong in the form (`unit.record-sheet`).
Don't build a bespoke summary block or activity list — always these two cards.

entries.title: Toolbar
entries.purpose: The list's control row (Pavan's original "Control unit"): narrow the list on the left (search, Filters, Group by), scope and present it on the right (date, display switch). It answers "how do I find the rows I want, and how do I want to see them?"
useWhen: Use when a page shows a list — always directly under `unit.view-row`, inside one `mt-4` shelf together with `unit.chip-shelf`.

Use the date control only on a list whose rows sit on a date (3PL › Delivery Orders, Sales › Orders, Service Work › Service Orders, Customer Portal › Orders). Omit it on lists with no date (Customers, Parts…).
Use the display switch only when a second display (board or map) exists.
dontUseWhen: Don't use for the view's own tools (Search by column, Show/hide columns, Card configuration) — they live in `unit.view-bar`.
Don't use inside a side sheet — a sheet's tables use the boxed table unit (ui §10f).

entries.title: View bar
entries.purpose: A strip ON the view — above the table header or above the board's lanes — that says what is shown ("62 orders · Thu, Oct 22, 2026") and carries that view's own tools. It answers "how many records am I looking at, over what window, and how do I adjust this view?"
useWhen: Use on every list with a table or a board (ui §10p — every list).
dontUseWhen: Don't use on a map view — the map has no view tools and the bar is not rendered for it.
Don't use for filters, search or the date — those are `unit.toolbar`.
Don't use inside a side sheet table.

entries.title: View row
entries.purpose: The first row of every list page: which saved narrowing you are on (All or a view you made), a way to save the current one, and the list's own actions (Create, Export). It answers "which version of this list am I looking at, and how do I add to it or take it out?"
useWhen: Use when a page shows a list of records (table, board or map) — every list page has one, at the top of the content layer.

Use the Create CTA as a **menu** (`createMenu`) only when Create means several different records that take different forms (Sales › Orders: Fuel Order / Asset Order / Quote; 3PL › Delivery Orders: Delivery Order / Asset Order).
dontUseWhen: Don't use for page-level actions that no list control scopes — those stay in the page header (ux "Action placement").
Don't use the row for business / line-of-service presets — those are filters in the `unit.filter-panel` (ui §10p).
Don't build a whole list from parts by hand when it is a plain table page — use `unit.standard-list`, which already contains this row.
